xinjianxue-skill-growth-global 1.0.0

- Initial release of the XinJianXue "Personal Growth Advisor" skill.
- Provides relationship analysis, personality & behavior reading, and emotional guidance using XinJianXue methods.
- Strict activation rules: user must clearly request the service and explicitly agree to analysis of themselves or a named/consenting person.
- Onboarding requires AI business license and user-supplied AI authorization code; subsequent requests require dual authentication.
- Includes detailed non-activation examples and required onboarding flow, focusing on consent and data privacy.
